title: We are tracking down entrepreneurs affected by Baling floods, says Noh Omar | The Star
text:
We are tracking down entrepreneurs affected by Baling floods, says Noh Omar | The Star
TANJONG KARANG: The Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives Ministry is in the midst of identifying micro, small and medium enterprises as well as entrepreneurs under the ministry who have been affected by the floods in Baling, Kedah on Monday (July 4).
Its Minister Tan Sri Noh Omar (pic) said the National Entrepreneur Group Economic Fund (Tekun) and Amanah Ikhtiar Malaysia (AIM) were currently collecting data of the victims.
